prompt: A 68-year-old man presents to the emergency department with chest pain that began 6 hours ago and is concerning for unstable angina/NSTEMI. He has hypertension, diabetes mellitus, and is an active smoker. Prior coronary angiography documented a 60% coronary stenosis. He reports 3 episodes of chest discomfort in the past 24 hours. He has taken aspirin regularly during the last 7 days. His ECG on presentation shows ST-segment depression, and troponin is elevated. Using the TIMI score for unstable angina/NSTEMI, what is his total TIMI score, and what is the corresponding 14-day risk interpretation?

rubric_items.text: States the total TIMI score for this patient is 7 (exact integer match required).
States the clinical interpretation: Risk of all-cause mortality, new or recurrent MI, or severe recurrent ischemia requiring urgent revascularization in 14 days is 41% (accept equivalent wording).
